description: Every language the product is offered in. English is the fallback for any string a translation has not caught up with, so it is the only locale guaranteed complete. Adding a language here is not enough on its own: each resource namespace needs a matching file under src/PowerPete.Analyzer.Domain/Localization/Resources, and the documentation needs a folder under docs.

namespaces.description: Every string in the web application.
The assessment report, which is the document a client reads.
Rule names, why it matters and recommendations. Translated because a Dutch consultant handing a Dutch report to a Dutch client cannot have the findings in English.
Work item titles, descriptions and acceptance criteria. Written in the language of the team who will pick them up, which is not always the language of the report.
The component inventory and findings workbooks.
